PDFs are merged entirely in your browser using pdf-lib. Nothing is uploaded to any server. Every page is copied exactly as it is — text, images, fonts and links are unchanged. Password-protected PDFs must be unlocked first.

How Merge PDF works

Add PDFs

Drop two or more PDF files — they never leave your device.

Arrange

Put the files in the order you want them in the merged PDF.

Download

Save one PDF containing every page of every file.

Frequently Asked Questions

Are my PDFs uploaded to a server?

No. MediaPilot merges the files entirely in your browser. Your PDFs never leave your device.

Will the quality change?

No. Pages are copied exactly as they are, not re-rendered, so text stays selectable and images keep their full quality.

Can I merge password-protected PDFs?

No. Remove the password first (open the PDF and save a copy without protection), then add it here.

How many files can I merge?

As many as you like, up to 300 MB in total (100 MB on phones).
